style.backgroundSystem: deep pine-green #1E5A50 poster panels, warm cream #F6EDD8 info panels, pure white #FFFFFF packshots
style.iconSystem: thin-line gold icons with blank round badge frames
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the front-left, gentle contact shadows, golden skimming light for shell texture
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent natural orchard dried-fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine-green #1E5A50, warm cream #F6EDD8, amber-gold #C9A25E and walnut brown #8A6849; warm soft studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with gold accent headings; thin-line gold icon style with blank round badge frames; clean appetizing food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product presentation with walnuts shown whole in-shell and cracked to reveal the kernel; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: walnuts shown whole in-shell in a shallow woven bamboo basket with one cracked open to reveal the kernel; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale
style.surfaceSystem: light natural wood plank #B08A63 and matte cream board #F6EDD8
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with gold accent headings
